a: Yazaalibwa nga Jeanne-Marie Bouvier de la Motte Guyon nga 13 Apuli 1648 mu Montargis, mu bukiikaddyo bwa Paris, mu maka ag'obugagga era ag'okutya Katonda; kitaawe, Claude Bouvier, yali mulamuzi assibwamu ekitiibwa. Ng'omwana ow'omutima omugonvu era ow'omunda eyayagala obutebenkevu okusinga emizannyo, yateekebwa mu buyambi bwa bannaddiini ab'Ursuline n'ab'Abenedikito, era ng'aweza emyaka musanvu gyokka yawulira okusikirizibwa okudda mu kifo ky'okwesibirako — wadde nga, ng'ekyennyini bwe yakyeyogerako mu bwesimbu, yasikirizibwanga n'eri obutaliimu n'okusiimibwa okw'ensi eyawagira obulungi bwe n'amagezi ge.

Ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'etaano, mu 1664, yagabirwa mu bufumbo Jacques Guyon, omusajja omugagga eyamusinga emyaka amakumi abiri mu ebiri, obufumbo obwategekebwa olw'obukuumi awatali kufaayo ku kwegomba kwe okuyingira mu kifo ky'okwesibirako. Tekwali kwegatta kwa ssanyu: ennyumba yali efugibwa maama wa bba omunywevu, era awaka we yakiyita «ennyumba y'ennaku». Kawaali mu 1670 kaamulekera enkovu ku maaso ensi ge yali ejjaganya, era abaana be abawerako baafa nga bato — «Okufa kw'abaana bange», bwe yawandiika, «kwali gye ndi kufa kw'okwagala nze ku bwange.»

Okumala emyaka yakolerera mu kusaba ng'akolerera mu mulimu, ng'akaka okufuna okwewaayo naye ng'asanga bukalu bwokka — «Nnanoonya Katonda ebweru, so ng'ali munda.» Akaseera akakyusa byonna kaatuuka mu 1668, omusajja Omufalansiskaani bwe yamugamba nti emirimu gye gyalemwa kubanga yanoonya ebweru we ekyo kye yali alina dda munda; aleke anoonye Katonda mu mutima gwe, era eyo anaamusanga. Okuva mu kaseera ako, bwe yawandiika, omutima gwe gwakyusibwa kyenkanyi — okusaba kwe yali agoba kwaweebwa, si ng'ekyafunibwa mu kufuba, wabula ng'okuzuula.

Oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwa bba yeewaayo mu kukyusa omwoyo okudda eri Katonda okwangu, okwa kasirise era okutaggwaawo, kwe yakolanga si mu ssaawa ezaateekebwawo zokka wabula mu mirimu gye egya bulijjo egy'olunaku. Yayigiriza nti okusaba si mulimu gw'obwongo nnyo ng'okuteeka omutima: «Ekkubo lyokka erigenda mu Ggulu kwe kusaba; okusaba okw'omutima, buli muntu asobola, so si okw'okuwakana okuli ekibala ky'okusoma. Abaavu bajje, abatasoma n'ab'omubiri bajje... era banaafuuka bagezi.»

Okufa kwa bba mu 1676 kwamuleka nnamwandu ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu munaana, omugagga era ow'eddembe okulonda obulamu obwangu. Mu kifo ky'ekyo yakyuka n'obumalirivu okudda eri Katonda, era wansi w'obulagirizi bwa François La Combe, omusaseeri Omubanabayiti, n'atambula mu Savoy ne mu Switzerland — Geneva, Annecy, Grenoble, Turin — ng'ayigiriza engeri ye ey'okusaba okw'omunda mu bifo by'okwesibirako n'eri abantu abaabulijjo. Yayiwa obugagga bwe mu kisa, ng'akakasa nti omwoyo ogusinga obwangu, ogutasoma era omwavu, gwasobola okusaba mu bwesimbu nga bwe gukola omuyivu yenna.

Yawandiika ebyafaayo by'obulamu bwe mu bwesimbu, ebyafulumizibwa oluvannyuma nga «Obulamu bwa Madame Guyon», era mu 1685 n'afulumya «Engeri Empi era Eyangu ey'Okusaba», akatabo akatono akaali kagenda okusinga obulamu buli luyombo lwonna olwamwetooloola, ng'akubiriza nti abakkiriza bonna, awatali kwesuula, bayitibwa era basobozesebwa okusaba. Ku bino yagattako okunnyonnyola ku Luyimba lwa Sulemaani ne «Enzizi z'Omwoyo», ekyalaga omwoyo ng'omugga ogubulira mu nnyanja: «Okusaba okw'amazima si kirala wabula okwagala kwa Katonda; kwe kubulira okwagala kwaffe mu kwe, ng'ettondo bwe libulira mu nnyanja.»

Olulimi lwe olw'okwerekereza, olw'okwagala okutukuvu era okutalina mululu, n'olw'okwaniriza Katonda mu bukkakkamu, lwawulikika eri abamunenya nga luli kumpi ennyo n'obulombolombo bwa Miguel de Molinos obwaligaanibwa. Ye kennyini yagaana bulijjo ebyo eby'obukanuki, ng'anywereza ku nsonga nti okwegatta okw'amazima ne Katonda tekuleeta butafaayo wabula obutukuvu. Mu bamulwanyisa okusinga kwavaayo Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet, Omulabirizi wa Meaux ow'amaanyi; enkuŋŋaana ez'e Issy mu 1694 ne 1695 zaakebera okuyigiriza kwe era ne ziggalawo oluggi ku kifo kye eky'olwatu.

Ng'akwatibwa emirundi n'emirundi, yakuumirwa mu Vincennes, Vaugirard, era ku nkomerero, mu 1698, mu Bastille — kumpi emyaka munaana gyonna mu kusibwa, ng'aggyibwako ebyamikwano era oluusi ng'atya okuttibwa n'obutwa. Ekyewuunyisa y'engeri gye yabonaabonamu: yawandiika nti amayinja g'ekkomera lye gaamasamasa mu maaso ge ng'amayinja ag'omuwendo, bwe yali ajjudde okubeerawo kwa Katonda, era yayimbanga mu kasenge ke — «Ndi kanyonyi katono, akaggaliddwa okuva mu bbanga; era mu kasenge kange nteeka n'eyimbira Oyo eyanteeka omwo.»

q: Omukwano gwe ogw'omwoyo ne Fénelon gwali gutya?
a: Mu 1688 yasisinkana François Fénelon, eyali agenda okufuuka omulabirizi omukulu wa Cambrai, era omukwano gwabwe gwafuuka gumu ku gisinga obukulu mu byafaayo by'eddiini mu Bufalansa. Kibuyaga w'eby'okutendekebwamu bwe yatuuka waggulu, okulwanirira kwa Fénelon okw'okwagala okutukuvu mu «Emisingi gy'Abatukuvu» kwaligaanibwa mu 1699, era n'akkiriza amangu mu bwetoowaze — naye teyaggyawo kitiibwa kye eri mukwano gwe: «Madame Guyon atambuliziddwa mu makubo abantu batono abategeera, naye omutima gwe gwonna gwa Katonda.»

q: Yafa atya, era kiki kye yaleka?
a: Ng'ateebwa ku mutemwa nti yeeyawula ku maaso g'abantu era nti tayigiriza nate, yamala emyaka gye egy'oluvannyuma wansi w'ekiziyiza mu Blois, abayigirizwa gye baali bakyanoonyeza amagezi ge. Yafiirayo nga 9 Juni 1717, ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu mwenda; ebigambo bye eby'enkomerero byali byangu nga okukkiriza kwe: «Njagala Katonda wange, era Katonda wange anjagala — ekyo kye kimu kyokka.» Ng'anenyezebwa mu Bufalansa ey'Abakatoliki, yaanirizibwa mu bifo ebirala: Pierre Poiret yafulumya emirimu gye, Gerhard Tersteegen yatwala ennyimba ze mu Bulaaya ey'Abaprotestanti, John Wesley yafunza ebyafaayo by'obulamu bwe, era abawandiisi ab'oluvannyuma nga A. W. Tozer ne Watchman Nee baakubiriza emirembe emipya okusoma obutabo bwe obutono.
